title: Case REQ-20261113-LIF005 — super fund cover note
content:
Super fund cover note for Mei Chen (CL-101934), case REQ-20261113-LIF005, prepared by the Claims Agent for Ben (Claims) while checking Mei's records for other cover.

Fund: Riverbend Super (industry fund). Mei's account held default death cover of $180,000.

How this claim works: it is separate from the Corella Life claim. Robert claims with Riverbend Super's trustee, not with Corella Life. The trustee pays Mei's super death benefit, including the $180,000 of insurance, under the fund's rules — here, to Robert as her spouse. Death benefits paid to a spouse are tax-free: a lump sum paid to a death-benefits dependant, which includes a spouse, is not taxed (Income Tax Assessment Act 1997 s302-60 and s302-195; see 'Tax on life insurance — premiums and benefits').

Checklist for Robert (sent with Cara's gentle letter, approved by Theo):
• Riverbend Super's death benefit claim form
• the certified copy of Mei's death certificate
• Robert's certified ID
• evidence of the relationship, if the fund asks for it
• a bank account in Robert's own name
Ben helps Robert complete the form, and Amelia stays his one named contact.

Status at 23 Nov 2026: claim under way with Riverbend Super's trustee.
